analysis.title: Early Morning Reid - Macro Strategy (17 November 2026)
key_insights: Third straight S&P 500 decline (-1.92% to 7417) on renewed AI slowdown fears. The Philly semiconductor index fell -5.28% on the day and -9.03% over three sessions, ahead of Nvidia earnings after the US close on 17 Nov.
The US Commerce Department announced that data centre operators across multiple countries will need a US government licence to buy advanced AI chips.

Nvidia closed -4.12% and is down -27% over three weeks. Trump said he 'would not mind' if Jensen Huang were reinstated as CEO, while Treasury Secretary Bessent said on Sunday the company needed a 'dramatic shake-up'.
Nvidia has often fallen the day after earnings in recent quarters, but the August report ended a run of 4 consecutive declines with a +8.74% next-day move.

Asia extended the tech selloff: KOSPI -1.95%, Nikkei -1.38%, Hang Seng -0.73%, Shanghai Comp -0.30%. CSI 300 is on course for its lowest close since July 2025. S&P 500 futures are -0.10% and NASDAQ 100 futures +0.14%, which suggests some stabilization.

Brent fell -3.55% to $92.44/bbl and is down another -0.81% to $91.69/bbl this morning. Drivers cited: continued Middle East oil flows, a possible supply glut next year, VP Vance saying the US will not accept a long-term commitment in the conflict, and AI-slowdown demand fears. European natural gas fell -6.82% to EUR84.75/MWh.
Commodities fell across the board: copper -1.36%, silver -3.55%, gold -0.72% to $3,856/oz (lowest since September 2025), sugar -1.68%, cotton -2.05%, wheat -0.95%.
Inflation expectations dropped: the 1yr Euro inflation swap fell -9.4bps to 3.13% and the US 1yr inflation swap fell -9.3bps to 2.07%.

The US 10yr yield was nearly unchanged (-0.4bps to 5.13%) because the 10yr real yield rose +3.1bps to 2.92%, a couple of basis points below the post-2008 high set in early October. 2yr yields fell -1.3bps, and hikes priced by September 2027 (the peak) fell -2.1bps to 85bps.
Cleveland Fed President Hammack supported moving in 'slow, steady increments, consistently, successively at meetings'.

The Dutch newspaper de Volkskrant reported that Klaas Knot will withdraw from the ECB presidency race this week, citing EU diplomats (not officially confirmed). That would clear the way for Pablo Hernandez de Cos. Lagarde stands down on February 7.

The STOXX 600 reversed from a likely record high to close -0.28%. 10yr bund yields rose +1.2bps, OATs +3.7bps and BTPs +2.7bps. EUR/USD fell below 1.10 for the first time since April 2025, closing at 1.0997.
Canada's October CPI was +3.1% y/y vs +3.2% expected. The Canadian 10yr yield fell -3.4bps to 3.82%, and the market-implied probability of a Bank of Canada hike in December fell from 62% to 46%.
The Empire State manufacturing survey for November was 7.8 vs 18.0 expected.

Today's calendar: US retail sales and industrial production for October, NAHB index, UK unemployment, German ZEW. Fed speakers: Musalem, Waller, Hammack, Williams. ECB speakers: Moulin, Cipollone, Lane. Earnings: Nvidia and Home Depot.

market_movers.rationale: Stock closed -4.12% and is down -27% over three weeks ahead of earnings after the close on 17 Nov. Chip export licensing and political commentary on management add to the focus.

earnings_insights: Nvidia reports after the US close on 17 Nov. The stock fell the day after earnings in several recent quarters, but rose +8.74% after the August report, which ended a run of 4 consecutive next-day declines.
Home Depot also reports on 17 Nov, with no estimates given in this note.

Continued oil flows out of the Middle East and a possible supply glut next year.
